title: Introduction To Phonetics   Phonology
modules: Major Components Of Language; Defining Phonetics And Phonology
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of symbols and is produced for the eyes."
Writing is made up of symbols and is produced for the eyes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of how speech sounds are produced."
Articulatory phonetics is the study of how speech sounds are produced.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the phoneme and the allophone."
The issues are the phoneme and the allophone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the smallest unit of pronunciation in a word."
A syllable is the smallest unit of pronunciation in a word.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the change sounds undergo for occurring in the same environment with other sounds."
Phonological process is the change sounds undergo for occurring in the same environment with other sounds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the context or environment in which the change occurs."
The slant '/' refers to the context or environment in which the change occurs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phonological process whereby unstressed vowels are weakend to schwa, this process abounds in English, e.g."
Vowel Reduction is a phonological process whereby unstressed vowels are weakend to schwa, this process abounds in English, e.g.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an important means of establishing the distinctive nature of a phoneme in English."
Minimal pairs are an important means of establishing the distinctive nature of a phoneme in English.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the least sonorous while vowels are the most sonorous."
Oral stops are the least sonorous while vowels are the most sonorous.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sound segment that has been found to possess significance in terms of its existence and meaningfulness within a language."
A phoneme is a sound segment that has been found to possess significance in terms of its existence and meaningfulness within a language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which are realized through the nose."
Nasal consonants are those which are realized through the nose.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phonological process whereby a non-nasal sound picks on the features of a nasal sound because it occurs in the same distributional environment. e.g."
Nasalisation is a phonological process whereby a non-nasal sound picks on the features of a nasal sound because it occurs in the same distributional environment. e.g.
fib: ______ is a process whereby sounds become less similar to their surrounding segments.
Dissimilation
Dissimilation is a process whereby sounds become less similar to their surrounding segments.
______ is a voiced, while 'y' and 'i' consonant are voiced sounds.
sound's
The sound's' is a voiced, while 'y' and 'i' consonant are voiced sounds.
______ is concerned with the study of the sounds of natural languages…languages into which human beings are born.
Phonetics
Phonetics is concerned with the study of the sounds of natural languages…languages into which human beings are born.
______ are a common and predictable part of phonological development often recognized as simple pronunciation alteration.
Phonological processes
Phonological processes are a common and predictable part of phonological development often recognized as simple pronunciation alteration.
______ are used to measure the characteristics of these sound waves.
Different instruments
Different instruments are used to measure the characteristics of these sound waves.
______ are those sounds which are generally produced (or realized) without any definite obstruction to the outflowing airstream used in their production.
vowels
The vowels are those sounds which are generally produced (or realized) without any definite obstruction to the outflowing airstream used in their production.
______ refers to the relationship between the two levels of language studies.
Interface between phonetics and phonology
Interface between phonetics and phonology refers to the relationship between the two levels of language studies.
______ are derived from the parameters for classification of sounds.
features
The features are derived from the parameters for classification of sounds.
______ is a phonological process whereby a sequence of two identical segments is reduced to one.
Contraction
Contraction is a phonological process whereby a sequence of two identical segments is reduced to one.
______ refers to a variety of pronunciation associated with a particular person or group.
Accent on the other hand
Accent on the other hand refers to a variety of pronunciation associated with a particular person or group.
______ is a branch of linguistics that deals with useful sounds of a specific language.
Phonology
Phonology is a branch of linguistics that deals with useful sounds of a specific language.
